_comment: Flagship readiness J (D-40). Each bundle is the exact, ordered run of shared modules it replaces. tools/build-bundles.js writes the bundle and swaps the run for one tag on every page that carries it CONTIGUOUSLY and IN THIS ORDER; a page that interleaves anything inside the run keeps its separate tags. Gates that scan source skip these outputs (they are copies of the members), and check-script-manifest.py expands them back into their members.
